snippet_primary: "As the merchant of record, Gumroad will be treated as the supplier or principal, for relevant Indirect Tax purposes, in respect of Products resold by Gumroad through the Services, and, subject to as provided pursuant to these Terms of Services, will be responsible for the administration, collection, reporting and remittance of any relevant Indirect Tax (except in limited circumstances where the Buyer may be responsible, for example as outlined in Section 10.5 below)."
subject_exact: Cláusula fiscal del modelo MoR: Gumroad tratado como supplier/principal para Indirect Tax en las reventas vía los Services, responsable de administración, recaudación, reporte y remisión, salvo circunstancias limitadas donde el Buyer puede ser responsable
